verdict.rationale: Together AI's serverless docs say embeddings are callable through the same single API as chat, image and audio. That supports doing embedding generation for retrieval on one vendor, but it is a single thin mention, and nothing in the pack shows reranking. Missing for 10: any evidence of a rerank endpoint or rerank models, a dedicated embeddings doc with model list and usage, and independent or hands-on corroboration of embeddings in retrieval pipelines.
